claim_boundary: Dependency scanning is best-effort engineering hygiene, not a security certification. Python advisory feeds do not consistently expose severity, so known-vulnerability counts are reported separately from npm high/critical counts. Accepted residual risks remain visible and expire; they are not treated as vulnerability removal.
